basis.method: Independent static inspection of own WP11 deltas and real source/state/UI producer contracts. No local product execution or typecheck.

findings.promotion: Always obtains current coverage entries when provider exists, including costCoverage equal to baseline, then uses canonical reassessment so synchronous commit proof binds exactly the persisted attributed result. Entry failures remain closed; absent provider is accepted only for unchanged coverage under existing downstream fences. No duplicate financial formula. Coverage validation still precedes source-fence gate.
findings.promotionRegression: Six scenarios: two actual source orderings with identical baseline coverage, canonical no-op result and real replace2242/null/conditioned, replay without new writes; four negatives for missing proof, revoked authority, actual Planner CAS edit, and actual C08 case edit. Shared private write WeakSet and current source identities retained. Pending-coverage fixture does not itself prove complete C10 coverage.
findings.hotTopicSnapshot: Dashboard is the correct domain snapshot for Dashboard Hot Topics. Case/preferences CAS and private write gate remain; successful draft changes only private state, not official domain records. Source/case/authority races before commit are denied.
findings.hotTopicRead: Clones incoming request. After all source/case/host callbacks, final C08 read atomically compares exact case, historical draft and active draft digests under current authority. No asynchronous product callback occurs after this final read. Real registry update to v2 inside second source callback makes old read stale while source and ACL remain valid.
findings.hotTopicList: Clones request and reuses one active-draft selector. Final C08 read atomically compares case and whole active-draft set after last case authorization/host callback. Fourth authorization callback in one-active-draft fixture advances actual registry to v2; old listing becomes stale, following listing exposes only v2.
findings.fixtureBoundary: Actual SQLite/C08, canonical Planner calculation, real scoped Dashboard source issuer/projection, explicit private test UI/human admissions. No browser/native session or real human participation is asserted.
findings.timeoutDelta: Only promotion test declarations changed after initial static review: explicit60000ms timeout for all6 generated scenarios. No assertion or authorization fence removed; no performance claim inferred.

requiredHostedValidation: Affected source-only complete coverage consumers and existing mutation/preparation regressions on exact final product candidate
claimBoundary: Static review is not a passing test result. W7 own-zero typecheck predates these4 deltas. Await exact W8 hosted checks and selected runtime tests.
